en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large ornamental fountain pool with powerful vertical and arcing water jets. Sculpted figures, including a reclining figure in the foreground, surround the basin. Trees and a classical building appear in the background. Printed French text at the bottom identifies the scene as the Neptune Basin at Versailles during the Grandes Eaux fountain display.
